training_dataset: DRIVE (train=16, val=4 of the 20-image training set; DRIVE test-set folder has no publicly distributed vessel ground truth in this download). Split is image-level, which IS patient-level here (DRIVE = one eye per subject).

eval_metrics.note: Validated on a 4-image held-out subset of DRIVE's 20 training images (no vessel ground truth exists for DRIVE's test folder in this download). Not cross-checked against STARE/CHASE_DB1 (not downloaded).
